cases.reason: The definitional arm requires a property of the USER'S PROGRAM, never one about the implementation. The defined property is storage placement on machine natural boundaries 'in such a way as to avoid such additional machine operations' (p3), and §1985:IV.4.3.7 p1 (checked OK: 'The way in which data is stored is determined by the object program') puts that placement in the object program, i.e. the implementation. The reader itself barred the definitional arm for p2 on exactly this ground ('its subject is the implementation'), and p3 is defined in p2's terms. Not decisive for the arm, so refuted by default: the row needs the same ruling p2 awaits, or an indistinguishable-consequent arm naming the SYNCHRONIZED clause rows.
